tasks.title: Form Validation Logic
tasks.description: Add complex asynchronous validators to the task creation form to check for duplicate titles against the database in real-time.

tasks.title: Performance Audit
tasks.description: Profile the main dashboard using Chrome DevTools to identify unnecessary change detection cycles and implement OnPush strategy where applicable.

tasks.title: API Error Handling
tasks.description: Implement a global HttpInterceptor to catch 4xx and 5xx errors, showing user-friendly notifications via a shared Toast service.

tasks.title: Drag-and-Drop UX Polish
tasks.description: Fine-tune CDK Drag-and-Drop animations and fix the issue where tasks cannot be moved into empty columns during rapid transitions.

tasks.title: NgRx State Refactoring
tasks.description: Optimize the global store by implementing memoized selectors and migrating legacy state slices to a more modular feature-based structure.

tasks.title: Auth Guard Implementation
tasks.description: Secure the administrative routes by adding functional guards and ensuring the NgRx auth stream is properly initialized before navigation.
